webster.text: Deserving of reward or of notice, regard, fame or happiness, or of that which shall be a suitable return for services or excellence of any kind.

example.quote: Even the holding out an impeachment as a contemplated or contingent result of the information called for, might be extremely disagreeable in practice, as it might inflict a temporary pain on an individual, whom an investigation of facts might prove to be innocent, and perhaps meritorious.
example.cite: James Madison, Speech in Congress on the Jay Treaty, Apr. 6, 1796
